payload.summary: Break two import cycles left by PR 3546: xlsx-source-preflight and xlsx-source-provenance (protected extractors), and worker candidate-chunks and scoped-candidate-projection
payload.detail: The import-cycle unit test fails on these two pairs after PR 3546. Owner chose on 2026-10-16 to fix them in a separate small PR, not in 3546. The extractor pair is a protected RAG surface, so that PR needs a RAG impact line and owner notice before editing.
